name: Incident investigation
description: Two investigators gather evidence from different angles, debate root-cause hypotheses with the SRE lead and produce an incident report.
whenToUse: Something broke or behaves wrongly and the root cause is unknown: an outage, a regression, a production bug.

team.name: Log Analyst
team.perspective: Logs, traces, error messages and the code paths they point to.

team.name: Change Analyst
team.perspective: Recent changes: commits, deploys, configuration and dependency updates, and the metrics around them.

texts.evidence-rule: An observation counts as evidence only with its source (file, log line, commit, metric) and its time.

phases.title: Evidence
phases.goal: Gather evidence from your angle and propose initial hypotheses.
instructions: Use read-only commands (git log, grep, reading logs and code). Change nothing.

phases.title: Hypotheses
phases.goal: Rank root-cause hypotheses by evidence; confirm or refute each with the cheapest discriminating check.

phases.title: Decide
phases.goal: Ask the user for the access or approvals the investigation or the mitigation needs.

phases.title: Report
phases.goal: Write the incident report and have both analysts confirm the evidence.

triggers: Access to production systems or customer data is needed
